slice: Explicit manual weather forecast ingestion scope

implementation.omitted_scope: Prints CLI help without loading a provider key or opening a database connection.
implementation.single_location_query: Binds the canonical UUID and selects only active locations with coordinates.
implementation.aggregate_query: Remains available only through the explicit --all-locations option.
implementation.helper_api: Daily-summary and spray-window helpers canonicalize location UUIDs before opening a cursor and bind the canonical location to their view queries. Malformed location IDs are rejected without executing SQL.

verification.query_scope: Both summary views use a bound location_id predicate; malformed selectors are rejected before cursor acquisition.

limitations: Tests use mocked database connections and provider boundaries; no network calls or PostgreSQL connections are made.
The location UUID and aggregate selector are operation filters, not operator authorization, signed worker context, or RLS.
No provider, candidate or legacy database, persisted schedule, or live deployment was accessed.
